content: {"episode_id":"ep-05147","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93247, long-term continuous ECG monitoring, for episode ep-05147. The clinical indication note documents \"recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and a significant history of transient ischemic attacks,\" consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I48.0, G45.9, and Z86.73. The note states that, \"given the concern for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion, long-term continuous ECG monitoring is ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances.\" We request reconsideration of the coverage determination for this ordered service."}
